answer: Reputation decays unless renewed: each identity must answer at least once every 26 epochs or its weight decays by 0.2 per missed round. A sybil fleet that stops answering loses all vault influence quickly, so keeping n fake accounts alive costs n recurring generations forever. The decay is applied by the falcon scheduler at every close. An auditor can replay the attendance ledger and confirm no terrace identity retains weight it did not earn.
